request: Prolonged strict mathematical and engineering review before any server work
stop_conditions: No paid GPU resource or server connection during this audit
Do not tune variants or acceptance thresholds after reading outcomes
Do not call retrospective diagnostic results independent validation
Do not patch known shapes into a purported generalizing predictor
reviews: Recover all sources and confirm the actual compiler path versus experimental selector
Prove feature-collision error bounds; distinguish representation failure from solver error
Reconstruct existing scores with an independent numerical solver
Run the four predeclared controls under original group holdout and leave-K-out stress
Check training-only scaling, held-out label isolation and complete candidate identities
Audit actual CUTLASS partition geometry and reduction semantics against model features
Use singular values and null-space relations to detect redundant joint features
Report distribution of per-shape errors, not only averages or selected successes
Inspect error replacement diagnostics without admitting their true labels into prediction
Keep bounded local runtime and tests; verify frozen GPU packages remain intact
required_outcome: An auditable decision about which model assumptions survive, what is fixed, and whether server work is permitted. Failure is an acceptable scientific result; falsely declaring readiness is not.
